name: Rain and neon text
what: Rain streaks fall on a dark ground and a glowing neon text switches on in the middle, blurred at first, then sharp, flickering twice while the rain crosses the letters; at the end it fades out again and the rain thins away, so it loops.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4-f60: rain thickens to a full field (streaks fall at 34 px a frame, 15.8 degrees right of vertical); f7-f36 the neon text fades in, blurred 8 px and 0.86x, sharpening to 1x while the glow builds; f71-f76, f106-f114 and f168-f176 it flickers (a dip to ~85 % light, ~70 % glow); f204-f232 it fades out blurred and shrinking to 0.78x while the rain thins out by f236.

tracks.name: rain
tracks.what: a field of falling streaks that thickens, then thins out at the end
tracks.easing: linear fall; density ramps over f4-f60 and f204-f236

tracks.name: neon on
tracks.what: the text fades in, blurred and 0.86x, then sharpens and grows to full size

tracks.name: flicker
tracks.what: short dips in light and glow, three bursts

tracks.name: neon off
tracks.what: the text fades out blurred and shrinking (the entry played backwards)
